title: 第5256章 任务下第5255章 任务上
lines: 幽寒国！
一个由四十九大小不同界域凝聚形成的莫大国度。
但要知道，这幽寒国所在的这片疆域，本就是这苍莽界外围里算是十分繁华的地方，此处强者可比要普通的疆域要多得多。
而这幽寒国却能在此处结合四十九个界域，形成一个国度，其实力绝对不容小觑。
幽寒国乃是由幽寒国主所创，这位幽寒国主据说许多年前就已经达到尊主三重前期层次，而如今便更加深不可测了。
在苍莽界外围，尊主三重前期，绝对能算最为顶尖的存在了。
要知道，平日里，人们所说的尊主前期强者一般指的是一重到三重的强者。
而在这外围，凡是上了尊主三重中期强者，便有资格称之为最顶尖尊主前期强者了。
而尊主三重中期强者，在那浩瀚的苍莽界中心恐怕有不少，但这里是苍莽界外围，尊主三重中期强者全都属于凤毛麟角的顶尖存在。
所以，以幽寒国主尊主三重前期的修为，足以称霸一方。
幽寒国所在的疆域，一片黑暗的虚空中。
穿着紫色衣袍，戴着紫色面具的江玄急速地掠行着，手里还拿着一份名单，在那里仔细地看着。
这份名单，乃是一份详细的强者名单。
按照此次任务上所写的资料，幽寒国崛起多年，早已是根深蒂固，其麾下有四十九个界域，浩瀚疆域全都完全掌控在幽寒国手里，可以说在这里，幽寒国就是绝对的王！
而这样庞大的一个国度，强者众多，这一些强者统治着这里的一切，久而久之，便滋生出一些败类。
根据碎星盟获得的确切信息，幽寒国里有足足上百名强者都是身怀罪孽的，其中被碎星盟认定罪大恶极之人，并且实力无比强横的，共有十二位。
那十二位强者就在江玄手里这份必杀名单上。
江玄此次任务，就是要将这上面的十二名强者尽数斩杀！
“这十二名强者，就算最弱的也是尊主二重前期强者，稍微强大一点的，就是尊主二重前期巅峰强者，另外还有三人是尊主二重中期！”
看着这份必杀名单上面的强者介绍，江玄也是忍不住唏嘘。
足足有十二名强者，还全都是尊主二重强者啊。
尊主二重，掌控了不死之身，单是击杀一位就十分艰难，要击杀十二位，这个任务对江玄而言的确很有挑战性。
并且在这十二位尊主二重里，还有三位是尊主二重中期强者。
尊主二重中期强者，要是放在两个月前，他也只能与之抗衡而已，但如今他的实力大涨，已经自信能胜过大多数尊主二重中期强者了。
不过，凡事没有绝对，更何况战胜击败，和斩杀对方，这完全就是两个概念。
这个任务，按道理来说应该由尊主二重后期强者去完成。
“以我目前的实力，想要击败这些尊主二重应该不难，但要将他们一一斩杀，这难度还是不小，还好我在临走时，特意去藏大人那里兑换了五十滴绝命毒液，只是不知道最后够不够用。”
“另外，我即便运气好把这份必杀名单上面的十二名强者尽数斩杀了，但事后我想要全身而退，恐怕不容易。”
江玄暗道。
他能够想象。
这份必杀名单上面的十二名强者都是幽寒国麾下的顶级强者，有的还为幽寒国立下过赫赫的功劳，有的更是这个国度的封疆大吏。
他要是只杀一两人，幽寒国高层想必还不会太在意。
但若一次性击杀十二位这种级别强者，幽寒国恐怕会震怒的，届时一定会想方设法去斩杀他。
这也就是说，此次任务，过程中很可能还会有不少的变故。
风险很大。
不过就因为这任务风险大，江玄才特意去接取。
三天后，幽寒国麾下的一座界域里，江玄来到了一片绵延无尽山脉中，在那下方还有着一座庞大的庄园。
“我要击杀的第一个目标，便住在这座庄园里。”
江玄冷漠站在那虚空，神魂力量却已经朝着下方的那座庄园覆盖过去。
在那片庄园的正中央，有着一座银色的殿宇。
咚！锵！铛！
content_en:
The cold country!
A huge country formed by forty-nine different realms.
But you must know that the territory where the Youhan Country is located is a very prosperous place on the outskirts of the vast world. There are many more powerful people here than in ordinary territories.
But this Youhan Country can combine forty-nine realms here to form a country, and its strength cannot be underestimated.
The Youhan Kingdom was created by the Lord of the Youhan Kingdom. It is said that the Lord of the Youhan Kingdom had reached the early stage of the third level of Lord many years ago, but now he is even more unfathomable.
On the outskirts of the vast world, the early stage of the third level Lord can definitely be regarded as the most top existence.
You know, in ordinary times, what people call a strong person in the early stage of the Lord generally refers to a strong person from the first level to the third level.
And in this peripheral area, anyone who has reached the third level of the mid-level Lord is qualified to be called the top early-stage Lord.
As for the powerful people in the middle stage of the third level of the Lord, there may be many in the center of the vast vast world, but this is the periphery of the vast world, and the powerful people in the middle stage of the third level of the Lord are all rare and top beings.
Therefore, with the early cultivation level of the third level Lord of Youhan Kingdom, he is enough to dominate a party.
The territory where Youhan Country is located is in a dark void.
Jiang Xuan, wearing a purple robe and a purple mask, walked quickly with a list in his hand and looked at it carefully.
This list is a detailed list of powerful people.
According to the information written on this mission, Youhan Kingdom has been rising for many years and has already been deeply rooted. It has forty-nine realms under its command. The vast territories are all completely controlled by Youhan Kingdom. It can be said that here, Youhan Kingdom is the absolute king!
In such a huge country, there are many strong people. These strong people rule everything here. Over time, some scum will breed.
According to the exact information obtained by the Broken Star Alliance, there are hundreds of strong men in Youhan Kingdom who are guilty of sins. Among them, there are a total of twelve people who are considered by the Broken Star Alliance to be extremely evil and extremely powerful.
Those twelve powerful men were on the must-kill list in Jiang Xuan's hands.
Jiang Xuan's mission this time is to kill all the twelve strong men above!
"Of these twelve strong men, even the weakest one is a master in the early stage of the second level of the Lord. The slightly stronger ones are the peak masters in the early stage of the second level of the Lord. The other three are in the middle stage of the second level of the Lord!"
Looking at the introduction of the strong men on this must-kill list, Jiang Xuan couldn't help but sigh.
There are a total of twelve strong men, and they are all second-level masters.
The second level of the Lord controls the immortal body. It is very difficult to kill just one person. To kill twelve people, this task is indeed very challenging for Jiang Xuan.
And among the twelve second-level lords, there are still three who are strong in the middle stage of the second-level lord.
Two months ago, he could only compete with the powerful mid-level Lord of the second level. But now his strength has greatly increased, and he is confident that he can defeat most of the powerful players of the second level of the Lord.
However, there is no absolute in everything, let alone defeating and killing the opponent, these are completely two concepts.
Logically speaking, this task should be completed by a strong person in the late second level of the Lord.
"With my current strength, it shouldn't be difficult to defeat these second-level lords, but it is still quite difficult to kill them one by one. Fortunately, before I left, I went to Master Zang to exchange for fifty drops of fatal venom, but I don't know if it will be enough in the end."
"Also, even if I'm lucky enough to kill all the twelve strong men on this must-kill list, I'm afraid it won't be easy for me to escape unscathed afterwards."
Jiang Xuan secretly said.
He could imagine.
The twelve strong men on this must-kill list are all the top strong men under the command of the Youhan Kingdom. Some have made great contributions to the Youhan Kingdom, and some are even the country's frontier officials.
If he only killed one or two people, the senior officials of Youhan Country would not care too much.
But if twelve powerful men of this level are killed at once, Youhan Kingdom will probably be furious, and will definitely find ways to kill him.
This means that there are likely to be many changes during this mission.
The stakes are high.
But just because this task was risky, Jiang Xuan went out of his way to take it on.
Three days later, in a realm under the Youhan Kingdom, Jiang Xuan came to an endless mountain range, with a huge manor below it.
"The first target I want to kill lives in this manor."
Jiang Xuan stood indifferently in the void, but the power of his soul was already covering the manor below.
In the center of the manor, there was a silver palace.
Boom! Clang! clang!
